subject: Pilot credits for LaunchBridge portfolio - eligibility & activation
messages:
From: Eleanor Wright <eleanor@launchbridge.vc>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:18:00Z
Subject: Request: Pilot credits for LaunchBridge portfolio startups

Hi Aisha,

I'm Eleanor, program manager at LaunchBridge Accelerator. We're planning a summer pilot for 12 early-stage startups in our June cohort and are exploring options to give each team a small credits allocation to evaluate Redwood for inference workloads during their proof-of-concept period.

High level:
- Cohort size: 12 companies (mostly seed/pre-seed)
- Expected usage: light experimentation, a handful of short generation tests + embeddings for search/semantic match (est. 25–50M tokens total across the cohort over 60 days)
- Ask: Are these kinds of program credits eligible for self-serve issuance? If so, what info do you need for verification and how quickly can we get credits into participant accounts?

I've attached a roster and a short affiliation statement for the accelerator. Happy to provide any additional paperwork.

Thanks,
Eleanor Wright
Program Manager | LaunchBridge Accelerator
eleanor@launchbridge.vc
Attachment: launchbridge_cohort_roster.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: accelerator_affiliation_statement.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Eleanor Wright <eleanor@launchbridge.vc>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits for LaunchBridge portfolio startups

Hi Eleanor — thanks for reaching out and for the attachments. Welcome!

Short answer: yes, LaunchBridge portfolio pilots fit our accelerator/VC credit program and we can support self-serve activation for individual founders. Before I submit this for approval/issuance I just need a couple quick clarifications so we size the grant correctly and ensure compliance with our program rules:

1) Confirmation that the startups are participating in LaunchBridge's official cohort (your affiliation statement helps; if there is a public cohort page or program ID that’s helpful).
2) Do you want one pooled credit amount to be distributed by you, or individual promo links per startup? We typically recommend per-startup self-serve links to avoid account ownership issues.
3) Any legal/PO/DocuSign requirement from your side? If you need a signature, we can route a simple DocuSign agreement.
4) Target activation window (start/end dates) — you mentioned ~60 days; when do you want the timer to start?

If it's helpful I can provision a pilot bundle (25M tokens per startup) and we can adjust after the first 2 weeks based on usage. I've cc'd Priyom to coordinate approvals and Dev for technical activation options.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Sales Programs | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0194

Thanks Aisha — quick answers below and I've attached a roster with company domains/contacts:

1) Yes, this is the official June cohort for LaunchBridge (Program ID: LB-2026-JUN). We also have a public page at https://launchbridge.vc/cohorts/june-2026.

3) No PO required on our side for <$10k total credits. If you need a signature for a pilot terms one pager, happy to sign.
4) Target activation window: we'd like codes to be redeemable starting 2026-06-10 and expiring 2026-08-09 (60 days).

Roster attached. Let me know what else you need. Really appreciate the fast help on this.

—Eleanor

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: dev_patel@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-02T10:00:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: Activation path for cohort promo links

Folks — quick internal note on this:

- External asked for 12 individual promo links, redeemable 2026-06-10 through 2026-08-09.
- Proposed allocation: 25M tokens per startup (grant type: promo-credit), total 300M tokens. Estimated hosted spend cap ~ $X (finance can confirm).
- Two technical options: (A) Generate per-email promo codes in the portal (self-serve redemption), or (B) Create a cohort-managed org and mint credits to 12 placeholder emails (less ideal).

Dev — can you confirm if the portal supports time-windowed promo codes that accept a list of recipient emails and expire automatically? If not, what's the quickest workaround we can support within 48 hours?

Aisha — if we proceed with per-email promo codes, I recommend we ask LaunchBridge to provide the list of founder emails (they already included them) and we generate codes tied to those addresses.

Thanks,
Priyom
Program Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-03T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Activation path for cohort promo links

Quick update — portal currently supports promo codes with an expiration date, but the UI does not accept a CSV of emails to pre-bind codes to addresses. Backend API does support creating codes programmatically and we can store an "assigned_to" email field for tracking; redemption will validate assignment. Estimated time: 24–36 hours to generate 12 time-windowed, email-bound promo codes and push the activation links. We'll also include a one-page activation instruction PDF with the link.

I'll prep the API script and deliver the promo codes plus an audit CSV (code, assigned_email, issued_at, expires_at). Priyom — please confirm budget approval and final token numbers so I can finalize the script.

—Dev
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Activation window: redeemable from 2026-06-10 through 2026-08-09

What we need from you (by 2026-06-08):

- If any founders prefer a pooled code for their team, flag that row in the roster.

What you'll receive from us:

- A single DocuSign link for a simple pilot terms one-pager (optional signature)
